0:
name: harbor
url: https://reg.xcd.dev/api/v2.0/health
conditions:
  - '[STATUS] == 200'
  - '[BODY].status == healthy'

data_dir: /vector-data-dir
api:
  enabled: false
sources:
  talos:
    type: socket
    mode: tcp
    address: 0.0.0.0:6050
    framing:
      method: newline_delimited
    decoding:
      codec: json
sinks:
  victorialogs:
    type: http
    inputs:
      - talos
    uri: http://victoria-logs-server.observability.svc.cluster.local:9428/insert/jsonline?_msg_field=msg&_time_field=talos-time&_stream_fields=talos-service,host
    encoding:
      codec: json
    framing:
      method: newline_delimited
    compression: gzip

modules:
  pon:
    http_client_config:
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true
    metrics:
      - name: pon_cpu1_temp_celsius

        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu2_tempC }"

        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_module_voltage
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .module_voltage }"

        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_optic_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .optic_tempC }"
        help: PON optics temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_ploam_state
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .ploam_state }"

        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_rx_power_dbm
        valuetype: gauge

      - name: pon_tx_power_dba
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_power_dBm }"
